facts.text: I attended a literary festival in the city.
I attended a book reading session by poet Rachel Patel today.
I found Rachel Patel's poetry moving and emotional.
I liked the way Rachel Patel used words to evoke feelings and paint vivid pictures.
I am interested in exploring poetry that focuses on themes of identity, love, and family.
I am particularly interested in poetry collections that explore the experience of women, especially women of color.
I am interested in exploring the experiences of women of color through poetry.
I want poetry anthologies that feature works by women of color.
I want to discover new voices and perspectives from women of color poets.
I want newer poetry anthologies from the past 5-10 years featuring works by emerging and established women poets of color.
I want to know more about the editors of the poetry anthologies from the past 5-10 years.
I want to know what inspired the editors to curate these collections.
